steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.

attacks.name: Gamma Bomb
steps: After this attack is resolved, if it dealt |!damage|, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.
After this attack is resolved, Place this character within |!range| 1 of the defender.
|!wild| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, Throw it |!movement_small|.

superPowers.name: I‘m the Strongest There Is!
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!movement_large|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Radiation Zone
superPowers.body: Each enemy character within |!range| 2 that has the |§poison§Poison| special condition suffers 2 |!damage|. Then each enemy character within |!range| 2 gains the Poison special condition. Each character that gained the Poison special condition in this way loses 1 |!power|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Gamma Mutated Hide
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1. After the effect is resolved, if this character suffered |!damage|, it gains 1 |!power|.

superPowers.name: Irradiated Strength
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.
